provenance.note: Census Geocoder Exact match: 1521 TEXAS PKWY, MISSOURI CITY, TX, 77489

inspection_summary.note: Texas HHSC inspections, report investigations and assessments since October 2017, updated daily.

occurrences.finding: Floors, ceilings and Walls in Good Repair and Clean: Multiple ceiling tiles were observed damaged and drooping to the point were the ceiling has an exposed gap or hole.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Floors, ceilings and Walls in Good Repair and Clean (26 TAC §746.3407(9))

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information - Emergency Contact: Four out of ten children did not have an emergency contact other than there parents. One out of ten children did not have a phone number or address of the emergency contact and one out of ten children did not have an emergency contact listed.    This was corrected during the inspection when the parents updated there child's admission information during pick-up
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information - Emergency Contact (26 TAC §746.605(6))

occurrences.finding: Fire Drill Monthly - Exit in 3 Minutes: For the month of April and May of 2026 the fire drill exit time was not within three minutes
occurrences.violation_type_title: Fire Drill Monthly - Exit in 3 Minutes (26 TAC §746.5205(1))

occurrences.finding: Installation and Maintenance of Loose-fill Surfacing - Six Inches if Equipment 5 Ft or Less: The surfacing on the playground is not at least six inches deep.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Installation and Maintenance of Loose-fill Surfacing - Six Inches if Equipment 5 Ft or Less (26 TAC §746.4907(a)(1))

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information - School Information for School-age Child: The admission form does not state the name of the school of two school age children.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information - Special Needs Statement (26 TAC §746.605(13))

occurrences.finding: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards: Three live ant beds were observed on the playground    This was corrected during the inspection when the owner sprayed the ant piles with ant killer
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards (26 TAC §746.3701)

occurrences.finding: Child/Caregiver Ratio - 18 Months Difference in Age: A twenty-eight month old child was mixed with a six month old infant.     This was corrected during the inspection when the director removed the child from the classroom.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Child/Caregiver Ratio - 18 Months Difference in Age (26 TAC §746.1605(1))

occurrences.finding: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children: A school-age teacher was present by themselves with twenty-seven children. The youngest child was six and the oldest child was twelve.     This was corrected during the inspection when the director moved a child to another classroom.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children (26 TAC §746.1601)

occurrences.finding: Screen Time Activities - Related to Planned Activities: School age children were observed playing video games on a computer. The games were not educational or apart of the planned activities.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Screen Time Activities - Related to Planned Activities (26 TAC §746.2207(c)(1))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know number of children responsible for: Two caregivers  in charge of 24 children 21mo-5years old was not aware of the number of children in their care. When I asked one caregiver they stated there were 23 children and then the other caregiver corrected her and stated no there's 25 children. However,  I counted 24 children. The caregiver was asked again to verify. The caregiver recounted and stated no there is 25 children. However I recounted again and there were 24 children. The caregiver then recounted again and she counted 24 children and stated one of the kids had went home.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know number of children responsible for (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: Safety - Poisonous Plants Inaccessible to Children: There were multiple mushrooms growing out of the ground outside on the playground.     This was corrected during the inspection when i observed the career remove the mushrooms.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - Poisonous Plants Inaccessible to Children (26 TAC §746.3701(6))

occurrences.finding: Infant Care Area - Space to Walk Between Cribs, Cots or Mats: The cribs were all next to each other with no room to walk in between.    This was corrected when the director, Rose Gainey, rearrranged the furniture while I was present.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Infant Care Area - Space to Walk Between Cribs, Cots or Mats (26 TAC §746.2403(5))

occurrences.finding: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Liability Insurance: The operation could not provide documentation of liability insurance coverage for review by licensing. The previous documents stated insurance coverage expired 04/28/2023.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Liability Insurance (26 TAC §746.801(6))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know number of children responsible for: The caregiver in the toddler class stated she had 24 children in care, but there were 25 children present.    This was corrected during the inspection when the caregiver recounted the children.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know number of children responsible for (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: Safety Precautions for Loading and Unloading Children - Account for All Children: Based on the DFPS investigation, there is sufficient evidence to suggest that a caregiver did not account for all children causing a child to be left on the vehicle.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety Precautions for Loading and Unloading Children - Account for All Children (26 TAC §746.5605(3))

occurrences.finding: AP Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Ensure No Child Abused, Neglected, or Exploited: Based on the DFPS investigation, there is sufficient evidence to suggest that neglectful supervision occurred at the operation when a child was found by a bystander away from the operation.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Ensure No Child Abused, Neglected, or Exploited (26 TAC §746.1201(4))

occurrences.finding: Electronic Child Safety Alarm - Driver or designated employee conduct walk-through and visual check of vehicle: Based on the DFPS investigation, there is sufficient evidence to suggest that the driver of the vehicle did not conduct a walk through or visual check of the inside of the vehicle after dropping the children off at school.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Electronic Child Safety Alarm - Driver or designated employee conduct walk-through and visual check of vehicle (26 TAC §746.5625(d)(2))

occurrences.finding: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity: Based on the DFPS investigation, there is sufficient evidence to suggest that supervision was not maintained when a child was left on a vehicle and then wandered away from the operation.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(4))
